stories.title: Security issues show AI needs greater human oversight, say Catholic experts
stories.simple_summary: Catholic experts say AI systems need more people checking on them to make sure they work safely and fairly.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a discussion among experts — nothing you need to act on right now, but it's good that people are thinking about keeping AI trustworthy.

stories.title: AI was supposed to destroy jobs. Where’s the carnage?
stories.simple_summary: Experts are noticing that AI hasn't eliminated as many jobs as people feared it would.
stories.why_it_matters: This suggests AI is changing jobs rather than destroying them completely, though some jobs may still shift in what they involve.

stories.title: How much time does AI save at work? New Census Bureau data breaks it down.
stories.simple_summary: Government data shows how much time AI actually saves workers when they use it in their jobs.
stories.why_it_matters: If you or your employees use AI tools, this data might help you understand whether they're worth the investment.

stories.title: Lovable confirms new $13.3B valuation, raises another $400M
stories.simple_summary: An AI software company called Lovable raised a lot of money from investors because it's making good revenue.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on, but it shows AI businesses are growing.

stories.title: Guitar company D’Addario admits that AI music was used in a promotional video
stories.simple_summary: A guitar supply company used AI to create music for an ad but denied it for weeks before admitting the truth.
stories.why_it_matters: If you advertise, be honest about using AI — people notice and care about transparency.

stories.title: How a $250 million acquisition collapsed into allegations of fraud and forged signatures
stories.simple_summary: A major AI deal involving $250 million fell apart because of fraud and forged documents.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it shows why you should be careful about the companies you do business with and verify things yourself.

stories.title: Spotify to introduce AI badge after fans make feelings 'clear'
stories.simple_summary: Spotify will add a badge to show which songs were created using AI, after listeners complained about not knowing.
stories.why_it_matters: If you listen to music or create it, you'll soon be able to see which songs used AI instead of real musicians.

stories.title: Everything announced at Made by Google ’26: Pixel 11, Pixel Watch 5, Pixel Tag, and tons of Gemini features
stories.simple_summary: Google announced new phones, a smart watch, a tracking device, and new AI features.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Google phones or watches, there will be new models with improved AI capabilities available soon.

stories.title: Google’s Pixel Watch 5 dives deeper into AI and health
stories.simple_summary: Google's latest watch costs $50 more than last year and focuses on using AI to help track your health.
stories.why_it_matters: If you wear a smartwatch, future versions will offer better health tracking through AI, though you'll pay more for it.

stories.title: Of course the ChatGPT dog cancer vaccine spawned a startup
stories.simple_summary: Someone used AI tools to help design a cancer vaccine for their dog, and now they've started a company to make personalized vaccines for pets.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have a dog with cancer, this might eventually become a new treatment option, though it's still very new.

stories.title: Meta and Nvidia plant 'very firm flag' in open-weight AI race led by Chinese Labs
stories.simple_summary: Meta and Nvidia are competing in the open-weight AI race, a competition mostly led by Chinese companies so far.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Grok is now an AI ‘teammate’ you can assign work
stories.simple_summary: A company called Grok created an AI 'teammate' that can log into your apps and websites to do work tasks automatically.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have repetitive computer tasks, this kind of AI could eventually save you time by handling them without your help.
